display_long_description:
They say penguins make the best astronauts. 

They can slide. They can fly. They can swim. They can fight if necessary. They will discover the truth.

Astro Penguin is an online multiplayer sandbox with a focus on natural-feeling movement, such as:

[media]
# THRUSTERS
Blast off. Or make a fist and thruster punch rocks. Hi-yah!

[media]
# WINGS
Glide. Flap. Maneuver with physics-based flight.

[media]
# WATER
Swim. Body-surf. Waterslides.

[media]
# DRIVE
Pilot vehicles across open worlds.

[media]
# PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Explore the penguinverse together. Or fight each other. Or play disc golf. Or go to a waterpark. Or more!
